title: Mid-cycle runway compression readout and resource reprioritization asks
creator: Asha Nair
description:
Executive readout packet for a mid-cycle condition: GPU capacity constraints and higher-than-expected inference demand compressed our roadmap runway for the next 6–8 weeks. This ticket captures the concise readout we will present to execs, the re-prioritization asks we need approval for, and the fallback plan to preserve customer SLAs.

Summary: forecasted dedicated capacity utilization has increased from 72% to 91% across EU/US regions due to two unexpectedly large customer onboarding events and higher model tokenization profiles. Constraint directly impacts three initiatives: dedicated-autoscale (high throughput), latency-1.0 (SLO improvements), and rollout-automation (canary pipelines). The packet recommends tactical deferrals and temporary capacity commitments to avoid customer-facing regressions.
decisions: Recommend deferring non-customer-facing feature 'rollout-automation v2' by one cycle (6 weeks) to free eng FTEs.
Approve temporary +12 GPU burst reservation for EU region through reserved-capacity spot purchase (cost estimate attached).
Adopt a strict per-route priority leash in the smart routing policy to protect latency SLOs for enterprise customers and degrade batch-able workloads first.
risks: If executive approval for burst capacity is rejected, risk of SLA violations for two enterprise customers increases to high within 14 days.
Deferring rollout-automation v2 removes an operational improvement that would reduce manual rollback time; this increases on-call toil in the short term.
Cost delta for burst capacity could increase monthly inference spend by ~8% vs baseline if demand remains elevated.
next_steps: Present 12-slide condensed readout to execs on 2026-03-15 (attached deck: Drive link above).
Request formal approval for +12 GPU burst (finance sign-off & procurement ticket) by 2026-03-17.
If approved, ENG to create implementation plan (ENG-14002) for capacity provisioning and routing policy changes with a 72-hour runway to enact.
Commence feature deferral sprint: PM to reassign scope from rollout-automation v2 to backlog; update release calendar and public roadmap.
acceptance_criteria: Exec approval recorded in meeting minutes or email thread with explicit capacity delta and budget acknowledgement.
If capacity approved, infra provisioning runbook executed and deployment validated by telemetry within 72 hours.
Public roadmap updated and customer-success notified of schedule impacts with suggested mitigations.
